subject: GRC connector onboarding & evidence exchange — scoping + runbook
messages:
From: Rita Chen <rita@knoxbridge.co>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@knoxbridge.co
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner GRC connector onboarding — initial scope

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this — KnoxBridge is evaluating a live connector to Redwood to pull evidence artifacts into our GRC workspace. We'd like to scope an onboarding runbook and confirm what artifacts you can share (SOC2, pen test summaries, key configuration screenshots, access log extracts). Our procurement team also needs an NDA in place before any service accounts are created.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm the mechanism (SFTP, presigned S3, or a connector API)?
- What evidence types are available and how redacted will they be?
- Estimated timeline to enable a read-only evidence feed (target: 3 weeks)

I've copied our procurement address for the NDA. I've attached a short intake packet that includes proposed timelines and our vendor onboarding questionnaire.

Attaching: KnoxBridge-intake.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Rita Chen
Head of Partnerships, KnoxBridge
rita@knoxbridge.co

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Rita Chen <rita@knoxbridge.co>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner GRC connector onboarding — initial scope

Hi Rita — great to connect. Thanks for the intake packet. I've looped in Vivek (partnerships) and Soojin (security/compliance) and Marissa (assurance partner ops) to help define a concise onboarding runbook.

Quick answers up front:
- Evidence exchange options we support: presigned S3 buckets (preferred for bulk artifacts), secure SFTP bridge (short-lived account), or a one-way connector API (for automated pulls). We'll propose presigned S3 + rotation policy by default.
- Typical artifact set we can provide: SOC2 Type II report (redacted where required), annual penetration test summary (high-level findings + remediation status), configuration screenshots for managed features, and limited access-log slices (last 90 days) with PII redacted.

Immediate next steps I suggest (mutual action plan):
1) Execute NDA (DocuSign link — I asked our legal to prep a standard partner NDA).
2) KnoxBridge to confirm desired exchange method and whitelist IPs (if SFTP).
3) Redwood to prepare a scoped artifact bundle and upload a sample to a presigned location for your intake team to validate.
4) Coordinate a 30-min runbook walkthrough to hand off operational touches (rotation, retention, contact matrix).

I've attached a short summary of our SOC2 posture and an internal guidance doc for evidence upload (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; redwood-evidence-upload-guidelines.md). Target for the sample upload: within 7 business days after NDA.

Do you have a preferred time next week for the runbook walkthrough?

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-evidence-upload-guidelines.md

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com

From: Rita Chen <rita@knoxbridge.co>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Fitz <alan.fitz@sentinellabs.io>, procurement@knoxbridge.co
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner GRC connector onboarding — initial scope

Dylan — thanks for the clarity. Procurement will sign the NDA today (I've nudged them). We can accept presigned S3 as the primary exchange mechanism. A couple of clarifying questions from our intake team:

- Will you accept ISO 27001 artifact summaries in addition to SOC2? (some of our auditors accept either)
- For the pen test summary, does Redwood redact IPs and internal hostnames by default? Knocking out those fields keeps our legal comfortable.

I've also looped in our pen test vendor (Alan at Sentinel Labs). Alan — can your team coordinate a scoping call with Soojin and the Redwood security team for any live testing needs?

I'm ok for a runbook walkthrough on Wed 17th at 11am PT if that works on your side.

Attaching: KnoxBridge-intake.pdf (updated), KnoxBridge-NDA-DocuSign.pdf

Regards,
Rita

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Partner GRC connector onboarding — please validate scope and runbook

Soojin/Vivek — forwarding Rita's note and the intake packet. Key ask: confirm what we can share as-is vs. what requires redaction or legal review, and whether Sentinel Labs requires any special firewall exceptions for scoping/testing. Points to cover before Wed 17th walkthrough: 

- Minimum artifact bundle (SOC2 summary, pen test summary (redacted), config screenshots, 90d access log slice)
- Standard redaction rules (IP, hostnames, customer identifiers) and who signs off
- Evidence retention & rotation policy we present to partners (current default: 90 days accessible, 1 year cold archive)
- Operational contacts and escalation path (service owner + security oncall)

On Wed 17th I'll host the runbook walkthrough with Rita/KnoxBridge and Alan from Sentinel Labs. Please reply with any objections or additions.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partner GRC connector onboarding — please validate scope and runbook

Thanks for the heads up and the draft plan. I reviewed the intake packet and propose the following runbook/checklist for the walkthrough — I attached a simple checklist. High level: we can provide the artifacts requested with standard redactions; pen test vendors should operate behind a scoped test IP allowlist and sign our penetration test engagement addendum.

Runbook highlights:
- NDA executed before any OTP or service account creation (procurement handled)
- Presigned S3 preferred. We will create a time-boxed bucket with 7-day presigned links per artifact and a rotation plan.
- SOC2 summary: provide the report and an internal control matrix (redacted for customer PII).
- Pen test summary: redact internal hostnames and private IPs; full findings only released to signed vendors on a per-engagement basis after an addendum.
- Logs: provide event slices (no raw payloads) — if KnoxBridge needs deeper traces, we require a formal data access review and customer approval.
- Evidence retention: active 90 days; archive 12 months (on request).
- Escalation matrix included in checklist with oncall window and SLA for artifact delivery (48 hours for standard deliveries, 5 business days for bespoke requests).

I'll join the Wed 17th walkthrough and can take the runbook lead. If Sentinel Labs wants to scope active testing, Alan — please share a formal scoping doc and proposed IP range.

Attaching: runbook-checklist.xlsx

Soojin Lee
Head of Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
